author: Vox
description:
Scientists have only recently started detecting objects that entered our solar system from other planetary systems. Because we have seen so few of them, their unusual properties can seem mysterious — or even alien.

On this week’s episode of Unexplainable, we explore why something unfamiliar is not necessarily evidence of extraterrestrial life with science internet guy Hank Green.

Watch on Netflix, or listen whenever you get your podcasts, this Monday.

author: Vox
description:
Taking a vacation right now is expensive — due to inflation and high fuel costs from the Iran war — and feels unattainable for many. And for those who do get to go on vacation, they’re often met with scrutiny from other countries for being American. 

Explain It to Me host Jonquilyn Hill talked to Business Insider’s Emily Stewart about how US foreign policy under the Trump administration causes American travellers to worry about how they will be perceived abroad.
